proof_body:
by
  intro Θ X Y _ _ _ _ _ l κ _ π _ hl
  exact ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_iInf_posterior_le_bayesRisk hl κ π
target_source: ∀ (Θ X Y : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Θ] [StandardBorelSpace Θ] [Nonempty Θ] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] (l : Θ → Y → ENNReal) (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel Θ X) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] (π : MeasureTheory.Measure Θ) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure π], Measurable (Function.uncurry l) → ∫⁻ x, ⨅ y : Y, ∫⁻ θ, l θ y ∂((ProbabilityTheory.posterior κ π) x) ∂(π.bind κ) ≤ ProbabilityTheory.bayesRisk l κ π
